fields.label: Event story
fields.sample:
The sequins are out, the records are dusted off and the disco ball is hanging from the ceiling. Tonight we’re rewinding time: the glitter of the seventies, the energy of the eighties and a dance floor that won’t stop until morning.
Check out the dress guide, practice your dance steps and come at your most dazzling.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample: Thank you for sharing the dance floor with us! The disco ball has gone dark, but tonight’s sparkle will stay with us for a long time.

elements.name: Üst başlık
elements.text: Dance floor on fire · Disco ball is up · Records ready

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: We’re rewinding time: sequins, vinyl and dancing till dawn! The dress guide, the night’s playlist and dance steps are inside.

elements.name: Plak künyesi
elements.text: Go Post Records · Dance Floor Classics, Vol. 1 · Stereo

elements.name: Künye notu
elements.text: Show your ticket at the door; pay on the dance floor.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: The time machine works: the disco ball is spinning again

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The se­quins are out of moth­balls, the records have been dusted off and the disco ball is hang­ing from the ceil­ing. Ac­cord­ing to a state­ment from the or­ga­niz­ing com­mit­tee, time will be re­wound all night long: the glit­ter of the sev­en­ties, the energy of the eight­ies and a dance floor that won’t stop until morning.
The hottest topic back­stage is who will wear the night’s most daz­zling outfit. Word has it that some guests have been re­hears­ing dance moves in front of the mirror for weeks, while others have only just learned to walk in plat­form shoes.
According to leaks from the DJ booth, the playlist in­cludes clas­sics ev­ery­one knows by heart as well as sur­pris­es pulled from the bottom of the record bag. Venue man­age­ment an­nounced that the dance floor will stay open until dawn and that slip­pers will be handed out at the door for anyone who wants to kick off their shoes and dance.
The night’s big sur­prise is a cos­tume con­test: the jury will award sep­a­rate prizes for the most daz­zling outfit, the bold­est dance move and the big­gest hair. The prizes are under wraps for now; the only clue is that they all sparkle. The dance guide, the fash­ion page and the night’s top 10 are on the inside pages.

elements.text: The week’s most-danced songs, compiled from leaks out of the DJ booth. Arrows show the change from last week; tonight, the dance floor decides the new ranking.

elements.name: Şarkı notu 1

elements.name: Şarkı notu 3

elements.name: Şarkı notu 4
elements.text: Shoulders start moving on their own

elements.name: Şarkı notu 8
elements.text: A surprise from the DJ’s bag

elements.name: Şarkı notu 9
elements.text: Couples to the floor, singles to the buffet

elements.name: Gece 1 altyazı
elements.text: The disco ball is up; lights in rehearsal.

elements.name: Gece 2 altyazı
elements.text: Star of the night: one sparkle from a thousand mirrors.

elements.name: Eleştiri
elements.text: Side A gets you up from the first note; Side B won’t let you catch your breath. Our critic con­fessed to being unable to sit still while lis­ten­ing — this review was writ­ten stand­ing up.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: The night’s shini­est jacket has a secret owner until the last minute. Hint: bold enough to rival the disco ball.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: Neigh­bors’ com­plaints re­vealed that two guests have been prac­tic­ing “Sat­ur­day Fever” moves in the kitchen for a week.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: One guest got a round of ap­plause trying to walk down the stairs in five-inch plat­forms; the guest is fine.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: Word is there are two bags of records in the booth — and one of them is noth­ing but sur­pris­es.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: Local beauty shops report that hair­spray stocks are van­ish­ing fast.

elements.name: Dedikodu
elements.text: It turns out two friends bought the same gold lamé jump­suit; who will change is still un­clear.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Step-by-step dance guide, fashion page and the night’s program: all you need to keep from getting lost on the floor.

elements.name: Adım notu Parmak yukarı
elements.text: Right hand up high, left on your hip. Wait for the beat; no rush.

elements.name: Adım notu Yana kaydırın
elements.text: Two steps right, two steps left; hips loose.

elements.name: Adım notu Döner ve poz verin
elements.text: Do a full turn, lower your shades, look at the camera.

elements.name: Adım notu Omuz dansı
elements.text: Feet planted, shoulders follow the bassline.

elements.name: Adım notu Zincir kurun
elements.text: Hands on the shoulders ahead; the train loops the floor.

elements.name: Adım notu Hep birlikte
elements.text: Chorus: everyone, same step — hands in the air!

elements.name: DJ altyazısı
elements.text: Final prep in the booth: the records are lined up.

elements.name: Moda girişi
elements.text: Tonight there’s just one rule: the shinier, the better.

elements.name: Moda notu Payet ve lame
elements.text: Enough to rival the disco ball.

elements.name: Moda notu İspanyol paça
elements.text: The wider the flare, the more you dance.

elements.name: Program notu 00.30
elements.text: Lights go down, the floor lights up

elements.name: Sahne altyazısı
elements.text: Live on stage: the mic is open to all.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: Is the night’s first song decided?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Yes, but I won’t say. You’ll know on the first note; the floor fills itself.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: What song do people request the most?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: They all ask for the same song under different names; I get it.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: Any song that empties the floor?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Yes: the “last song” call. I put that off till morning.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Two bags of records, a thermos of tea and a spare disco ball bulb.

elements.name: Arka fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: The night’s finale: sparklers, raised glasses and endless laughter.

elements.name: Bölüm Disko burçları · Yıldızlar ne diyor?
elements.text: Disco horoscope · What do the stars say?

elements.name: Burç yorumu Boğa
elements.text: You’ll bounce between buffet and dance floor.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Yengeç
elements.text: The slow song will make you tear up.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Aslan
elements.text: You’re the star of the disco ball.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Terazi
elements.text: You can’t decide between sequins and lamé.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Oğlak
elements.text: You won’t be home before two.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Kova
elements.text: You’ll make new friends on the dance floor.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Balık
elements.text: When the lights go out, you’ll still be dancing.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: One platform shoe, silver, size 9. Awaiting its owner.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Dance partner who won’t step on my feet during the slow song. References required.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Sequined jacket, lightly shined. Matches the disco ball.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Disco ball, by the hour. Spinning guaranteed; dizziness not covered.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: As of midnight, hairspray stocks have run out.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: To all who kept the floor alive till morning — from our shoes.

elements.name: Alt bilgi
elements.text: Go Post · Night edition · Not for sale; handed out on the dance floor.
